what: Title split into letters, each letter randomly offset to one of six spots (top-left 60·32px, bottom-left 30·32, bottom-right 28·12 …) and left transparent. When a letter touches the line 200px past screen center, it jolts six times over .7s with steps(6) into place and turns on, then shakes ±10° for 1s in jumps (no in-between values) — a record special page title that looks like hand-cut pasted letters

options.spread: Dodge distance multiplier, default 1 (original px as is)
options.dur: Duration of arriving in place (s), default .7 — 0 means instant
options.start: Start position for each character (ScrollTrigger start), default center center+=200

note: Words are bundled into inline-block chunks so Korean line breaks never split a word in the middle

from.where: index.html section titles, subheadings, comment text (.hatasumika·.hatasumika2) — original .kata1~12 (top·left random offset) gsap.fromTo opacity 0→1, position 0, .7s steps(6), start center center+=200, onStart kata_shake (1s linear kata keyframes)
